conceptIntro.heading: Write Equations to Represent Relationships Between Two Variables
conceptIntro.intro: An equation shows the whole pattern in a table. It works for any number, not only the numbers in the table.
conceptIntro.introEs: Una ecuación muestra todo el patrón de una tabla. Funciona con cualquier número, no solo con los números de la tabla.

iDo.title: Example · Write an equation from a table
iDo.titleEs: Ejemplo · Escribe una ecuación a partir de una tabla
lines: A gym membership costs $24.95 for 1 month, $49.90 for 2 months and $74.85 for 3 months. Write an equation for the total cost. Then find the cost of 10 months.
Name the variables: m = months · c = total cost
Write the 1-month column in the table: (1, 24.95)
Multiply both quantities by m: c = 24.95 × m = 24.95m
Find the scale factor from 2 to 10 months: 10 ÷ 2 = 5
Do the same to the cost: 49.90 × 5 = 249.50
The equation is c = 24.95m. Ten months cost $249.50.
linesEs: Una membresía de gimnasio cuesta $24.95 por 1 mes, $49.90 por 2 meses y $74.85 por 3 meses. Escribe una ecuación para el costo total. Luego halla el costo de 10 meses.
Nombra las variables: m = meses · c = costo total
Escribe la columna de 1 mes en la tabla: (1, 24.95)
Multiplica las dos cantidades por m: c = 24.95 × m = 24.95m
Halla el factor de escala de 2 a 10 meses: 10 ÷ 2 = 5
Haz lo mismo con el costo: 49.90 × 5 = 249.50
La ecuación es c = 24.95m. Diez meses cuestan $249.50.

weDo.title: Let's do one together
lines: A canoe rents for $15 per hour. Write an equation for the total cost of a canoe rental.
Which quantity is independent: hours or total cost? (Hours. The total cost depends on the hours.)
Say the pattern in words. (The total cost equals $15 times the number of hours.)
Let h = hours and c = total cost. Write the equation. (c = 15h)
Check the equation. What do 3 hours cost? What do 5 hours cost? (15 × 3 = 45 and 15 × 5 = 75, so $45 and $75.)
linesEs: Una canoa se alquila por $15 la hora. Escribe una ecuación para el costo total del alquiler de la canoa.
¿Qué cantidad es independiente: las horas o el costo total? (Las horas. El costo total depende de las horas.)
Di el patrón con palabras. (El costo total es igual a $15 por el número de horas.)
Sea h = horas y c = costo total. Escribe la ecuación. (c = 15h)
Comprueba la ecuación. ¿Cuánto cuestan 3 horas? ¿Cuánto cuestan 5 horas? (15 × 3 = 45 and 15 × 5 = 75, so $45 and $75.)

topic: Write Equations to Represent Relationships Between Two Variables

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Music Downloads
revealWordProblem.text:
Diamond is considering the online music service shown. She can purchase songs for $0.75 each, or pay $80 per year for unlimited streaming.
Question: Would you recommend that Diamond purchase or stream songs from the online music service? Write an equation for each plan and use it to explain your recommendation.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A Music Mix advertisement listing $0.75 per song to purchase and $80 per year for unlimited streaming.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Let s be the whole number of songs purchased in one year and c the annual cost in dollars. Purchasing: c = 0.75s. Streaming: c = 80. The equal-cost calculation is 0.75s = 80, so s = 106 2/3; there is no whole-number song count at which the plans cost exactly the same. At 106 songs, purchasing costs $79.50; at 107 songs, it costs $80.25. Purchasing is cheaper for 0–106 songs, and streaming is cheaper for 107 or more songs. Choose based on the expected number of songs and whether Diamond wants to own downloads or access them through an annual subscription.
